name: 洛雪音源
description: 洛雪(LX Music)音源内联运行时:把你自己的洛雪音源 .js 直接放进 MusicFlow 沙箱执行,自动解析@name/@version/@author 头并注册成可用音源,提供取链播放 / 搜索(音源支持时) / 歌词 / 封面。不需要洛雪服务端,也不需要指向任何外部服务地址。某个音源失效会自动回退到其它已配置音源;本插件整体不可用(全部音源均无结果/报错)时,核心「搜索兜底」会自动改用其它已启用的源插件再试一次(结果来自哪个插件与回退轨迹会回传前端)。注意:本插件会在你的 MusicFlow 服务进程内执行第三方音源脚本,等价于运行不是你写的程序,请只添加你信任的音源;默认不启用。
author: ray5378

configSchema.label: 音源列表
configSchema.help:
一行一个洛雪音源(点 + 添加行、✕ 删除行),每行支持三种写法:
1) .js 文件 URL,如 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/.../latest.js
2) 本地文件名(放在「音源文件目录」下,支持子目录),如 huibq/latest.js
3) 「显示名=文件名或URL」。
所有加入的行都会生效;插件不预置任何音源内容,第三方音源由你自己添加并承担风险。

configSchema.label: 音源文件目录
configSchema.help: 本地 .js 音源的根目录(插件相对目录,如 lx-sources);列表里写绝对路径时忽略本项

configSchema.label: 音质
configSchema.help: 取播放链接时请求的音质档(洛雪标准档位);音源不支持该档时会明确报错并自动回退下一音源

configSchema.label: 并发加载音源数
configSchema.help: 测试/自检时同时加载几个音源(1~8)。插件必须主线程执行(jsenv 子环境不能在 worker 里用),受默认 20 秒预算约束,音源多时需要并发才跑得完

configSchema.label: 音源脚本缓存有效期(小时)
configSchema.help: URL 音源的脚本缓存到插件目录后的有效期(小时,0=永不过期)。缓存命中时不再联网下载,出网不稳定的环境靠它把音源固化下来

configSchema.label: 单次网络超时(毫秒)
configSchema.help: 音源请求超时;超时视为该音源本次失败并自动回退下一音源

configSchema.label: 最多加载音源数
configSchema.help: 0=不限制,音源列表里所有行都会加载;>0 时只加载前 N 个(防止脚本过多吃满沙箱内存)

configSchema.label: 搜索时预取播放链接
configSchema.help: 搜索/歌单返回后立即为前若干首调音源 musicUrl 预取直链并缓存;关掉可减少对音源 API 的请求频率

configSchema.label: 单次预取歌曲数上限
configSchema.help: 每次搜索/歌单最多预取多少首的直链(1~50)

configSchema.label: 音源报错自动回退
configSchema.help: 某音源执行报错(403/风控/脚本异常)时自动改用下一个可用音源,并把回退轨迹记进返回 message

configSchema.label: 音源空结果自动回退
configSchema.help: 某音源返回空结果时自动改用下一个可用音源(对冷门曲目很有用)

documentation:
### 功能
把洛雪音乐音源 .js 直接跑在 MusicFlow 沙箱里,解析出源(酷我/酷狗/网易/…)并提供
取链播放、搜索(仅当音源声明 musicSearch/search)、歌词、封面。不需要洛雪客户端,也不需要额外服务端。

### 能力边界(按真实音源协议)
洛雪标准协议的 request actions 只有 musicSearch/musicUrl/lyric/pic,
不含专辑/歌单搜索与每日推荐 —— 本插件对齐声明以便服务端无缝接入,但对音源不支持的能力会返回
明确的空结果+原因,首页推荐/歌单由 go-music-dl 等插件提供。

### 风险提示
本插件会在你的 MusicFlow 服务进程内执行第三方音源脚本,等同于运行不是你写的程序;
插件不预置任何音源内容。请只添加你信任的音源,并建议在家庭局域网内自用。

### 配置
- 音源列表:`;` 分隔的 URL 或本地文件名(可带「显示名=...」);
- 音质档、超时、最大音源数、搜索预取直链开关与上限;
- 回退:音源报错 / 空结果自动回退到下一个可用音源(可分别开关)。

### 失败可见
下载失败、语法错、顶层抛错(如要求去官网下载新版)、未注册任何源、取链 403/超时,
都会给出原文与脚本位置,并记录回退轨迹,绝不静默返回空结果。

### 音源 URL 与「已加载但未注册任何源」
音源 URL 一律用 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<owner>/<repo>/<分支>/<路径> 直链:实测部分内网环境可达 raw.githubusercontent.com 但不可达 cdn.jsdelivr.net,用 jsdelivr 会直接「音源下载失败」。
「已加载但未注册任何源」= 文件下载成功且脚本已在沙箱里执行,但没有完成 sources 注册,常见于该音源依赖浏览器环境(window/document/localStorage),或需要宿主下发运行期配置才能初始化。
排查看「测试」结果明细里的诊断后缀 (state=…,handlers=N,net=M):handlers=0 且 net=0 说明脚本没挂上任何 lx 监听;handlers>0 说明脚本执行了、注册卡在网络或宿主能力;net>0 说明沙箱网络桥已通。

### 与 go-music-dl 的分工
go-music-dl 覆盖 12 个主流版权平台与首页推荐;本插件走洛雪音源生态
(冷门/下架/长尾聚合 + 音源可自行热替换,不必改代码发版)。两者可并存,核心按
sourcePreference 排序取源;本插件整体不可用时,核心会自动使用 go-music-dl 等其它已启用插件。

### 主线程约束(不要声明 longRunning)
本插件方法依赖 jsenv 子环境;longRunning 中的方法会被路由到 worker 线程,worker 下 host.jsenv 不可用,会导致「脚本下载成功却注册不上任何源」。故 longRunning 恒为空。

en.name: LX Music Sources
en.description: Inlines LX Music source scripts into the MusicFlow sandbox: parses the @name/@version header and registers the sources with stream URL resolving, search (when the source declares it), lyrics and covers. No LX server, no external service address. If a source fails, the next configured source is used automatically; if the whole plugin is unusable, the core falls back to other enabled source plugins. Warning: this plugin executes third-party source scripts inside your MusicFlow server process; add only sources you trust and keep it LAN-only. Disabled by default.

sources.label: Sources (one per row)
sources.help: LX source .js URLs or local file names, one per row; use 'Name=...' to rename.

sourceDir.label: Source directory
sourceDir.help: Root dir for local .js sources (default lx-sources); absolute paths ignore this.

quality.label: Quality
quality.help: Preferred quality tier when fetching a playable URL.

timeoutMs.label: Network timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.help: Timeout for a single fetch; on failure the next source is tried.

maxSources.label: Max sources
maxSources.help: 0 = load every row; >0 caps how many scripts load at once.

prefetchStreams.label: Prefetch stream URLs on search
prefetchStreams.help: Resolve playable URLs right after a search and cache them.

prefetchMax.label: Prefetch cap per search
prefetchMax.help: Max songs to prefetch per search/playlist (1~50).

fallbackOnError.label: Auto fallback on error
fallbackOnError.help: Try the next source when one errors (403 / anti-bot / script exception).

fallbackOnEmpty.label: Auto fallback on empty
fallbackOnEmpty.help: Try the next source when one returns no results.

concurrency.label: Concurrent source loads
concurrency.help: How many sources load in parallel (1-8). The plugin must run on the main thread (jsenv is unavailable in worker threads) and is bound by the default 20s budget.

cacheTtlHours.label: Source script cache TTL (hours)
cacheTtlHours.help: How long a downloaded source script stays cached on disk (0 = never expire). Cache hits skip the network entirely.

en.documentation:
### Features
Runs LX Music source scripts inside the MusicFlow QuickJS sandbox and exposes stream URL resolving, search (sources that declare musicSearch/search), lyrics and covers. No LX client and no extra service.

### Capability boundary
The LX request protocol only defines musicSearch/musicUrl/lyric/pic actions; album/playlist search and daily recommendations are not part of it, so those methods return an explicit empty result with the reason.

### Warning
Executes third-party scripts in your MusicFlow process; add only sources you trust.

### Config
- Sources: semicolon-separated URLs or file names;
- Quality / timeout / max sources / prefetch;
- Fallback on error and on empty (auto-switch to the next working source).

### Source URLs and 'loaded but no sources registered'
Always use raw.githubusercontent.com direct links (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<owner>/<repo>/<branch>/<path>): on some LAN setups raw.githubusercontent.com is reachable while cdn.jsdelivr.net is not, so jsdelivr URLs fail with 'download failed'.
'Loaded but no sources registered' means the file downloaded and the script ran inside the sandbox, yet it never registered its sources — usually because the source needs a browser environment (window/document/localStorage) or runtime config pushed by the host.
Read the (state=…,handlers=N,net=M) diagnostic suffix in the Test result: handlers=0 with net=0 means no lx listener was attached at all; handlers>0 means the script ran but registration is blocked on network or host capabilities; net>0 means the sandbox network bridge works.

### Failure visibility
Download errors, syntax errors, top-level throws, sources registering nothing, 403/timeouts are all reported with the original message; silent empty results never happen.

### Main thread only (no longRunning)
Methods declared in longRunning run in a worker thread where host.jsenv is unavailable, which makes sources silently fail to register. longRunning is therefore always empty.
